allowed_changes: one fixed canonical four-return-day turn-of-month window: last trading day of month M plus first three trading days of M+1
implement that window by entering 50/50 Nasdaq/S&P 500 at the penultimate trading-day close of M and exiting at the third trading-day close of M+1
hold cash outside the window using the existing CashYieldCNY model
use U.S. exchange-session date metadata only to identify trading-day ordinal; no price/return information enters calendar selection
one rest-of-month control and one 0.05% adverse-slippage-per-fill stress
expected_outputs: trade count, active target sessions, average cash, realized max gross, minimum cash and target fingerprint
run authorization, execution commit and SHA artifact manifest
follow_up_policy: After any formal performance metric is viewed, do not change calendar window, dates, weights, asset set, execution cadence, fee, slippage or add conditioning filters inside this lineage. Any further seasonal or calendar idea is a new preregistered lineage.
forbidden_changes: testing alternative month-end or month-start window lengths after viewing results
weekday, holiday, January, quarter-end or tax-calendar subfilters
trend, volatility, momentum, gap, VIX, NFCI or macro filters
changing 50/50 Nasdaq/S&P weights or dropping either asset
daily rebalancing inside the active window; only entry and exit transitions may trade
shorting, borrowing, financing, leverage, gross exposure above 100% or negative cash
changing fee or stress slippage after viewing results
hypothesis: Institutional month-end rebalancing and beginning-of-month contribution flows concentrate a disproportionate share of U.S. equity returns around the turn of the month. Holding a fixed 50/50 Nasdaq and S&P 500 portfolio from the penultimate trading-day close through the third trading-day close of the next month should produce a repeatable positive close-to-close return stream with materially lower trading frequency than daily strategies.
pass_fail_gates: at least 70% of seven fixed folds have Sharpe >0
max realized gross <=100%, cash >=0, target path fee-invariant
selection_metric: No within-family selection. One canonical turn-of-month window only. Validation, objective attainment and comparison are reported independently under ATM-SVP-3.

shared_rules.entry: penultimate trading-day close of each month
shared_rules.exit: third trading-day close of next month

target fingerprint is invariant to stress cost
